lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 5 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is irregular with a wider gap between the third and fourth lines relative to the anterior segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior line terminates prematurely in the mid-lateral torso; the posterior-most line is a truncated vertical segment restricted to the upper haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper hind limb/haunch area arranged in a loose trapezoidal pattern.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature characterized by an outward lateral sweep from the base followed by an inward medial curve towards the apical points.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 2.4 times the pixel width of the visible left horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory tipping occupies approximately 0.12 of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white transverse chevron on the bridge of the muzzle, two distinct white spots on the lower cheek, and a dark ventral fringe of elongated hair.
